summary: No repository dataset was found that gives paired homologous measurements (bilateral or fore/hind) with matched non-homologous measurements per individual; AVONET holds individual-level bird measurements whose trait columns were not opened, and the Dryad marsupial forelimb dataset covers interspecific integration within one limb.
next_step: Open the AVONET raw sheet to see whether wing and tarsus-type measurements are paired per individual; otherwise measure left/right and fore/hind elements from MorphoSource meshes for a pre-registered species list.
obstacles_confirmed: Within-species covariance matrices are published piecemeal, not as a global download.
Measuring existing scans at comparative scale is months of work.
Public morphology repositories often lack pedigrees needed for genetic covariance.
